name: project-praxis
description: Project Praxis — constitutional docs + implementation repository

scripts.lint: npm run lint:md && npm run -ws --if-present lint
scripts.test:a11y: CI_WEB_SERVER_COMMAND='npm run -w @praxis/planner dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4173' playwright test tests/a11y/inbox-today.a11y.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:axe: CI_WEB_SERVER_COMMAND='npm run -w @praxis/planner dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4173' playwright test tests/a11y/inbox-today.a11y.spec.ts --grep 'axe scan'
scripts.test:e2e:keyboard: CI_WEB_SERVER_COMMAND='npm run -w @praxis/planner dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4173' playwright test tests/a11y/inbox-today.a11y.spec.ts --grep 'keyboard focus'
